report:
Toe, left 2nd toe, amputation

Received in formalin is an amputated digit labelled left 2nd toe, measuring 6 x 2.5 x 2 cm. Representative sections of the soft tissue, the bone and the proximal bone margin in 3 blocks after decalcification.

(1-3) Digit, representative sections, decalcified.

Sections of the soft tissue show gangrenous necrosis with acute inflammation. Sections of the bone show necrotic bone with empty osteocyte lacunae, marrow fibrosis, a chronic inflammatory infiltrate of lymphocytes and plasma cells, and reactive new bone formation. The features are in keeping with chronic osteomyelitis. The proximal bone margin shows viable bone with no osteomyelitis. There is no evidence of malignancy.

TOE, left 2nd toe, amputation - GANGRENE with CHRONIC OSTEOMYELITIS; proximal bone margin viable, no osteomyelitis
